scope: Static review of the frozen R3 Cargo metadata/index-resolution packet only. This is not execution or qualification approval beyond Root's separate authorization decision.
findings: All announced packet pins match the current files, and all entries in SHA256SUMS verify.

The runner and plan bind one exact Cargo 1.98.1 command: update --workspace --dry-run --locked --manifest-path <candidate>/Cargo.toml. The runner spawns one child, with a 600-second deadline, 10-second TERM/KILL and close bounds, and an 8 MiB combined stdout/stderr cap; there is no retry loop.

R2's metadata attempt and R3b's offline generator failure are hash-pinned and checked before execution. R2 is accurately classified incomplete (45 packages/members, resolve=null, reqwest index absent, no cache delta); R3b remains a failed offline attempt with no preview.

Candidate HEAD/tree/index/status/lock/config, exact locked source kinds and cached Tuiscotti revision are verified. The R3b private Cargo home is re-walked and pinned; only additions/updates under registry/index and bounded content changes to three exact pre-existing Cargo bookkeeping files are accepted. Root physical-directory identity/mode is rechecked after the child. Crate archives, registry/src, Git source, target and all other deltas fail closed.

The clean child environment uses private HOME/TMP/XDG/target and the pinned Git wrapper for Git CLI operations; source/tool hashes and Cargo config search paths are checked. The current preflight reports PREFLIGHT_PASS_NOT_RUN and confirms the R3 run-root is absent.
important_limit: Cargo 1.98.1 update dry-run resolves before warning that it will not write the lockfile, and skips the writer where --locked mismatch validation occurs. Accordingly the packet correctly does not claim that --locked validates a hypothetical updated graph; actual Cargo.lock byte identity is checked. A successful run would only establish the narrowly stated index-resolution result, not complete cache closure, build/test/generator qualification, or release qualification.
reviewer_actions: Read-only file/source inspection and SHA-256 verification only. No Cargo, CLI, tests, network, cache mutation, or source edits were performed.
